remarks: Welcome to The Gables on Glenbrook and this meticulously maintained, bright 2-bed, 2.5 bath townhouse, conveniently located within walking distance of Stamford's vibrant downtown, offering exceptional dining, shopping, and entertainment for that discerning buyer! Transportation routes are in close proximity and provide easy access for a weekend excursion to a local beach, park, or neighboring town, or for those commuting to NYC and beyond. Every detail in this home has been carefully addressed, starting with the freshly painted walls, ceilings, and trim throughout, as well as the beautifully maintained oak hardwood floors. 9 ceilings in the entryway and 1st floor add volume and provide a sense of openness. A stylish new chandelier brightens the dining room, with dual hanging lanterns complimenting the entryway, and additional recessed lighting throughout the unit enhances the modern feel. The kitchen is well-appointed with granite countertops, travertine tile backsplash, newer LG stainless steel appliances, and cherry cabinets, providing a warm welcoming feel for that aspiring chef. The unit also includes a nicely updated 2-car garage, providing secure off-street parking and storage. Many other updates are included, so don't miss the chance to own this beautiful gem!
